newsitem.title: USA: U.S. seeks bids from power plants to make tritium.
newsitem.headline: U.S. seeks bids from power plants to make tritium.

text.p: The U.S. Energy Department announced Tuesday it was seeking bids from commercial nuclear reactors to help produce tritium for the nation's nuclear weapons.

It said it was soliciting bids from commercial power plants to either provide irradiation services to produce tritium or to sell a reactor to the government to produce the gas, which is used to activate fusion in a nuclear weapon.
The U.S. government stopped producing tritium in 1988, and expects to run out of current supplies from dismantled weapons by 2005.
The Energy Department said it planned to decide in 1998 whether to use commercial reactors or an accelerator as its main source of tritium in the future.
